statement: You are given an array prices, where prices[i] is the price of a stock on day i.
You may buy one share on one day and sell it on a later day. You make at most one such trade.
Return the largest profit you can make. If no trade makes money, return 0.

examples.explanation: Buy on day 1 at price 1 and sell on day 4 at price 6, for a profit of 5.
The price falls every day, so any trade loses money. The best choice is not to trade.
